requiresNewEntries.meaning: The task requires confirming a value not present in the available result records directly with this control. False means no such creation capability is required; it does not assert UI quality.
requiresNewEntries.assessment: Task requirement, declared by user/product author.

requiredCardinality.meaning: Maximum number of records the user must be able to confirm together through this component instance.
requiredCardinality.assessment: Task requirement, declared by user/product author.

resultLabelsFamiliar.meaning: The intended audience can recognize the presented result labels in this task context.
resultLabelsFamiliar.assessment: Human review or user research; never inferred merely from nonempty label strings.

missingAndNull: Both evaluate unknown; the wrapper preserves distinct missing and explicit-null diagnostics. Wrong types stay raw and are evaluated invalid-input, never coerced.
notModelled: Novel value creation via an additional component
